visual.general_description: Five laparoscopic intraoperative still images (A to E) from the diagnostic laparoscopy, each marked with its letter at the lower right.
visual.detailed_description: A composite of five circular endoscopic views on dark surrounds. A shows pale yellow lobulated tissue with surface vessels and pink membranous strands. B and D show instruments over dark red tissue with debris. C shows a white looped plastic tube end held by a grasper. E shows red-pink tissue with a tan-yellow lobulated mass in a central cleft and no instruments. No patient names, dates, institution names or scale bars are visible.

panels.general_description: Laparoscopic view of pale yellow lobulated tissue and pink membranous tissue against a pink-gray surface, letter A printed at the lower right.
panels.detailed_description: Circular endoscopic field on a dark surround. The center-right shows a pale yellow lobulated tissue mass with a fine network of small surface vessels. Thin pink membranous bands and strands extend from it toward a pink-gray surface on the left and upper area. No instruments or text other than the letter A at the lower right are visible. Which structures are bowel, omentum or abdominal wall could not be told apart from pixels alone.
